backendDrivenDepartures: Community-local authenticated APIs, MOSS and authority adapters remain decentralized. No centralized auth, API client, persona runtime, router or workspace import is adopted.

Consent is versioned/bound to the sealed reservation before recording/file acceptance, within the existing capture notice and Record action. Live terms admission is held; no new speculative acceptance screen or public consent control is added.
V5 local decision intent/outbox and separately verified canonical event seconds replace centralized applied-at verdict semantics. Final ABI/hash/source admission and activation remain held.

Private access is rechecked on every media GET/HEAD/range. A witness is not a playback capability. Host mounts must compose Dance.inspect and supply current authority/identity handling; no media URL enters the journal.
Owner queue buttons call the host controller instead of centralized router links. The same queue/detail interaction is retained; root owns final routes and navigation.
remainingAcceptance: Root mount preserves centralized selection/Do this dance entry without duplicating it and composes actual media/camera/review ports.
Root supplies current community session/identity handling and browser private-page lifecycle, including pagehide/back-forward-cache restoration, at the admitted mount.
Deferred combined D1/Worker/browser tests cover preview/submit/resume/cancel, 401/403 cleanup, all private byte routes, permissions, visibility/restoration, mobile footer, focus and no-pose rubric.
Actual canonical verifier/ABI/source and terms/public capability policy acceptance are separate held gates.
